data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The nocturnal UHI gap is primarily a sky-view-factor effect: dense urban geometry reduces the effective emissivity of the surface-atmosphere system by trapping longwave radiation, so cities with lower mean sky view retain more heat after sunset regardless of thermal mass or anthropogenic input.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If longwave radiative flux measurements show no significant difference between urban canyon and rural surfaces after accounting for temperature differences, sky view is not the mechanism","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If two cities with identical sky view factors but different thermal masses show very different nocturnal UHI magnitudes, sky view alone is insufficient","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the UHI gap develops before significant radiative cooling has occurred (e.g., immediately after sunset), radiative trapping cannot be the primary cause","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the gap is largest in cities with low building density but high anthropogenic heat, sky view is not the dominant modulator","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"On a clear, calm night, the dominant cooling mechanism is radiative loss to space via the atmospheric window. Rural surfaces with an unobstructed hemispherical view (sky view factor near 1) cool efficiently by emitting longwave radiation to a cold sky. Urban street canyons with a sky view factor of 0.3\u20130.6 emit the same longwave radiation, but a large fraction intercepts opposing building walls and the canyon floor, which re-emit a portion back. This radiative trapping effectively reduces the net longwave cooling rate. The nocturnal UHI is therefore the integral of this reduced cooling over the hours since sunset, and the cross-city modulator is the mean sky view factor: cities with deeper, denser canyons cool more slowly and develop a larger nocturnal gap.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
